layout_sources: https://github.com/huin/accountmerge/blob/master/src/importers/nationwide_csv.rs (decodes Windows-1252; rows "Account Name:", "Account Balance:", "Available Balance:" then the header Date, Transaction type, Description, Paid out, Paid in, Balance; dates "%d %b %Y"; amounts "£NNN.NN", minus after the pound sign, no thousands mark)

https://github.com/callummarshall9/BankingSimulation/blob/master/BankingSimulation.UI/BankingSimulationDependencyInstaller.cs (2024 example: every cell quoted, "Available Balance: " with a trailing space, a blank line, "10 Apr 2024", and the £ turned into U+FFFD because it was not UTF-8)
https://github.com/wmanley/nationwide2homebank/blob/master/nationwide2homebank.py (older layout; splits amounts on the 0xA3 pound byte)
notes: Three account rows ("Account Name:", "Account Balance:", "Available Balance: " with its trailing space), a blank line, then the table. Every cell quoted. Dates "DD Mon YYYY". Separate Paid out / Paid in, running Balance, each with a £ sign and no thousands mark. Oldest first. Windows-1252, so £ is the single byte A3. The £ names the currency (GBP). CRLF assumed for a Windows-1252 export (not confirmed). The account rows give the balance at download, here the closing.
